review_basis: frozen MEXT Chemistry Basics quantitative-chemistry range

decisions.rationale: Mole unit is foundational and absent from canonical 111.
Molar-concentration definition establishes the target's core relationship.
Direct n/V calculation is the minimal application of the definition.
Uses the same direct n/V path as C003 with only numeric values changed; insufficient incremental value.
Solves the inverse cV form and tests a different unknown.
Adds required mL→L conversion before applying cV.
Combines mL→L conversion with n/V rather than cV.
Solves for volume V=n/c; a distinct rearrangement and decision path.
Requires computing and comparing two concentrations, countering amount-only reasoning.
Fixed amount / doubled volume tests inverse proportionality.
Fixed volume / doubled amount tests numerator proportionality.
Simultaneous equal scaling tests concentration invariance.
Targets the common solvent-volume versus final-solution-volume misconception.
The mL→L misconception is already materially exercised by accepted C006 and C007; an isolated first-step question is redundant.
Same mass→moles→molarity chain as C016 with easier numbers; retain only the stronger representative.
Two-step mass→amount→concentration calculation adds a materially distinct chained reasoning burden.

collision_review.note: No accepted B8 proposition exists in canonical 111. Three same-path variants are rejected to preserve density without filler.

source_review_scope: Final canonical source verification remains separate after integration.
